subject: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs (shared; NOT modified by this family)
observation: MC 227a lays its captions out in horizontal bands — a four-column table header, a three-cell court block, an ORI/address/telephone strip, a two-option plaintiff election. groupIntoLines groups a band into ONE line, so a blank in the band harvests the whole band as its caption, including the words printed over a DIFFERENT column. Every consequence of that on this form is listed below.
whyItIsNotFixedHere: The capture module is shared by every family in the corpus and is outside this family's owned path. Changing how captions are harvested would change the binding of forms this family has not looked at. It is reported for whoever owns that module; here each consequence is refused by role and the refusal is proved from the artifact bytes.

wrongBindings.wouldHavePrinted: 24-CR-001234 in the MCL citation / PACC Code column
wrongBindings.why: The words CASE NUMBER are the header of the fourth column, measured at x 496.3 to 555.8; this blank's own column band is x 218.4 to 387.0.
wrongBindings.disposition: refused by role; proved absent from both fixtures

wrongBindings.wouldHavePrinted: District Court in the box that wants a circuit number
wrongBindings.why: Each caption in this block is printed to the RIGHT of its own box on the same line; the harvester reads the line above, which is the preceding cell's caption.
wrongBindings.disposition: refused by role; proved absent from both fixtures

wrongBindings.wouldHavePrinted: the participant's telephone number as the court's address
wrongBindings.why: Three separate captions on one printed line; `telephone` reaches both boxes under it.
wrongBindings.disposition: refused by role; proved absent from both fixtures

wrongBindings.wouldHavePrinted: the participant's telephone number as the court's telephone number
wrongBindings.disposition: refused by role; proved absent from both fixtures

wrongBindings.measuredCaptionForThisBox: (the second option of the THE PEOPLE OF election; no caption of its own)
wrongBindings.wouldHavePrinted: the participant's residence state as the prosecuting authority
wrongBindings.why: The caption harvested is the printed text of the OTHER option in a two-option election.
wrongBindings.disposition: refused by role; proved absent from both fixtures

correctBindingDespiteAMisharvestedCaptio.why: The caption COUNTY is printed to the RIGHT of this box on the same baseline, so the harvester's line-above rule takes the preceding row's caption instead. The field's own NAME is `county `, which matches matter.county directly, and the name channel is tried first — so the wrong label never reached the decision. The binding is correct; the label displayed beside it is not.
correctBindingDespiteAMisharvestedCaptio.fieldNameNote: The AcroForm name carries a trailing space, "county ". It is preserved verbatim in every record this family writes, because trimming it would silently address a different field.
